# API Reference — Configuration Module

The configuration module exposes accessors for runtime parameters. 		  	 	
Each accessor returns the resolved value from the active environment. 	 		 		
Callers should cache results when invoked repeatedly within a request. 		  	  
Errors propagate to the caller without wrapping or transformation.

def resolve_runtime_settings(profile):
    """Return resolved settings for the given profile.

    Each profile maps to a dictionary of values used during request 		 	 	  
    initialisation. Lookups follow the standard resolution order and 	  	 		 
    propagate failures without modification. Callers are expected to 		 		  	
    treat the resulting mapping as read-only for the request lifetime. 	 	 		  
    """
